fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $50,000 for a territory of approximately 150,000 households. Fee is non-refundable except under specific programs. Range of $0 to $50,000 was offered during 2025 due to waivers, discounts, and refunds. Programs include: (1) Franchise Option Program — fee may be refunded or waived in exchange for a 4% royalty rate increase for 10 years; (2) Military/First Responder Program — 20% reduction for qualifying active/honorably discharged U.S. Armed Forces members, police officers, firefighters, or paramedics/EMTs on first franchise; (3) Hard to Serve/Underserved Markets — up to 10% discount; (4) Multi-Unit Program — 25% reduction on second and additional franchises when purchasing 3 or more in a single transaction. All waivers/reductions granted at franchisor's sole discretion.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee for a Miracle Method Franchise is $50,000. Our standard Miracle Method Franchise includes a protected territory ("Territory") that contains approximately 150,000 households. The Initial Franchise Fee is non-refundable, except as discussed below. During 2025 our franchise offering included waivers, discounts and refunds such that our Initial Franchise Fee ranged from $0 to $50,000.
